name: intelligent-financial-fraud-detection-system
description: AI/ML-Powered Financial Fraud Detection System with Real-Time Risk Scoring, Anomaly Detection & Analyst Investigation Platform

scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../ml-service && uv venv && uv pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.train:ml: cd ml-service && uv run python training/train_models.py
scripts.start:ml: cd ml-service && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ML" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:ml"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: cd frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
